attchmntText: Suprajit Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Press Release and Investors Presentation dated November 7, 2026'.
voiceSummary: Suprajit Engineering Limited filed its press release and investor presentation for the second quarter of fiscal year 2026-2027, ending September 2026. Consolidated revenue grew by 20.6% to 11,351 million INR, with EBITDA rising 26.7% to 1,384 million INR. Standalone revenue increased 15.9% to 5,647 million INR, and EBITDA rose 5% to 889 million INR. The Global Cables and Mechatronics division reported revenue growth of 24.3% and EBITDA growth of 69%. India Cables and Mechatronics saw revenue growth of 13.7% and EBITDA growth of 3.8%. Phoenix Lighting and Electricals recorded revenue growth of 14.8% and EBITDA growth of 30.3%. Sensors, Electronics and Displays achieved revenue growth of 50.4%, though EBITDA declined by 5.5%. Net debt decreased to 3,714 million INR from 4,485 million INR in March 2026.

attchmntText: Suprajit Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Steffen Berns as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. January 01, 2027.
voiceSummary: Suprajit Engineering Limited has recommended the appointment of Dr. Steffen Berns, DIN 06449396, as a Non-Executive Independent Director. The appointment is subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot. The term is three years, effective from January 1, 2027, to December 31, 2029. Dr. Berns holds a PhD in Mechanical Engineering and has over 30 years of executive experience in the Bosch Group. He is not related to any director of the company and is not debarred from holding office.

attchmntText: Suprajit Engineering Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Suprajit Engineering Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the half-year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations stood at Rs. 10,343.37 million, with a profit after tax of Rs. 1,154.36 million. Earnings per share were Rs. 8.41. The Board recommended the appointment of Dr. Steffen Berns, DIN 06449396, as a Non-Executive Independent Director for three years from January 1, 2027, to December 31, 2029. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval through postal ballot. The Board met on November 7, 2026, to approve these results and the director recommendation.
